verdict.rationale: Render's docs state you can "define, deploy, and version your entire architecture with a single YAML file" and "manage your multi-service architecture with a single YAML file". The CLI can validate `render.yaml` Blueprint files, and a community user independently praises the docker-compose-like infrastructure-as-code approach kept under version control. Missing for 10: in-depth Blueprint spec documentation showing which resource types (databases, caches, workers, env groups) a single file covers, and details on how file changes sync and redeploy on push.
